title: What is AI Agent and Its Origin

slides.title: Introduction to AI Agents
slides.content:
What is an AI Agent?

An AI Agent is a system that perceives its environment and takes actions to achieve goals. It's an autonomous entity capable of planning, reasoning, and executing tasks to reach a desired outcome.

Origin: The concept stems from the field of Artificial Intelligence, drawing from early AI concepts like goal-oriented planning and rational agents.

slides.title: Agent Architecture
slides.content:
Key Components of an AI Agent

AI Agents typically consist of four core components:

  • Perception: Sensing the environment (e.g., reading data, observing state).
  • Reasoning: Processing information to decide on the best course of action.
  • Action: Executing the plan to interact with the environment.
  • Memory: Storing past experiences to inform future decisions.

These components work together in a feedback loop to enable autonomous decision-making.

slides.title: Evolution of AI Agents
slides.content:
Historical Context & Evolution

The journey of AI Agents involves several major milestones:

  • Early AI (1950s-1970s): Focus on symbolic reasoning and expert systems.
  • The Rise of Goal-Oriented Systems (1980s): Introduction of search algorithms and planning techniques.
  • Modern AI & Machine Learning (2000s-Present): Emergence of Deep Learning, Reinforcement Learning, and modern LLM-based agents.

The shift has been from explicitly programmed rules to learning-based, adaptive systems.
